card.title: Prophecy Under Revision
card.instruction: Project absolute certainty about what happens next while quietly revising the prophecy whenever reality disagrees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the telescope ready. The moon will turn green at noon, exactly as I foretold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Noon where the prophecy was written. We have six hours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote it here. I lent you the pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An imported pen. The change will occur at its factory's noon. Keep watching while I check the label.

mechanism: A keeps the green-moon forecast certain by moving its noon reference whenever observed facts contradict the prediction.
confusable: Unlike openly changing a hypothesis, A presents each change as the original prophecy still being exactly right.
comparison: This alternative shifts the time zone through the pen; the other reverses who receives a promised fortune after a plumber's bill.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
